newsitem.title: UK: August Brent down 3 cargoes from revised July.
newsitem.headline: August Brent down 3 cargoes from revised July.

text.p: The August North Sea Brent crude oil loading programme has been set at the equivalent of 38.5 cargoes, made up of 36 full cargoes and 1.213 million barrels in top-ups, traders said on Tuesday.
This compares to a revised July programme of 37 full cargoes plus 2.264 million barrels in top-ups. The is the equivalent of 41.5 full cargoes.
The original July programme had contained 36 full cargoes plus 2.264 million barrels in top-ups.
